parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the DTS task. The DTS task can be a data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task.

parameters.name: JobProgressId
parameters.description: The ID of the primary key.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the DTS instance. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to query only zero-extract, transform, load (ETL) integration tasks. Valid values:

*   **true**: yes.
*   **false**: no.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts skip-full-job-table --dts-job-id l3m1213ye7l0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --job-progress-id 123 --zero-etl-job true --resource-group-id rg-aek2ilvoxlrdcby --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts SkipFullJobTable --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId l3m1213ye7l0000 --JobProgressId 123 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aek2ilvoxlrdcby' --ZeroEtlJob true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
